lines: A wrong turn on Highway 62, an hour before sunset.
Yours was the only other car at the lookout.
We shared a thermos of coffee and stayed for the stars.
Six years, one old truck and a very small dog later…
… he asked again, on the same patch of warm sand.
Now we would love you there for all the rest of it.
Bring shoes you can walk on sand in.
And something warm for the night.
Rancho Alma, just off Border Avenue.
Twenty minutes from the west gate of the park.
Parking on site — we'll wave you in.

info.title: Getting there
info.body: Palm Springs is the closest airport, two hours by car. A shuttle leaves town at 3 pm and brings everyone back at midnight.

info.title: What to wear
info.body: Desert formal. Flat soles for the sand, and a layer for the moment the sun drops behind the rocks.

info.title: Staying over
info.body: We are holding a block of rooms in town. Say so in your reply and we will send you the booking link.
